description: The file contains utility functions for creating mock HTTP requests and responses for testing purposes, such as makeBaseReq, makeReq, makeStalledReq, makeRes, and makeFormBody.

methods.name: export function makeBaseReq( makeBaseReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object with specified HTTP method and options, including headers and URL, and a destroy method.

methods.name: export function makeReq( makeReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object with a body, simulating a complete HTTP request, using makeBaseReq and emitting data and end events.

methods.name: export function makeStalledReq( makeStalledReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object without body data, simulating a stalled or incomplete request, using makeBaseReq.

methods.name: export function makeRes(): ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string } { makeRes
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with methods to set status code and body, useful for testing server responses.

methods.name: export function makeFormBody(fields: Record<string, string>): string { makeFormBody
methods.description: Serializes a record of form fields into a URL-encoded form body string.

ctags.name: _body
ctags.pattern: /^  } as unknown as ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string };$/

ctags.name: req
ctags.pattern: /^  const req = new EventEmitter() as IncomingMessage & { destroyed: boolean };$/
